title: 彭博能源主编：中国天然气有压力点，广东地区夏季或现气荒
speaker: Steven Stachinsky

segments.en: And on the media term, there are some pressure points. And I think one of them still is natural gas, 30% of their LNG came from Qatar last year. And while the country itself also again like oils very insulated, they've got domestic gas supply, they've got inventories, they've also got pipeline imports from Russia.
segments.zh: 中期存在压力点，天然气是其中之一。去年中国30%的LNG来自卡塔尔，尽管有国内供应、库存和俄罗斯管道气，但仍有压力。

segments.en: The LNG actually does play a somewhat key role in the Guangdong region of China, and that region is basically China's factory. It might not be well known to the rest of the world, but it's basically, it's got the economic power of South Korea.
segments.zh: LNG在广东地区扮演关键角色，该地区堪称中国工厂，经济规模相当于韩国。

segments.en: It's huge. And because of its location on China's eastern coast, they do import quite a bit of LNG for power production as well as use in pet camps and other industries. And so if it starts to get really hot, for example, this summer, and if there's a draining of hydro facilities, then you could see a crunch in China for gas if they're not able to get what they're getting from the Middle East, likewise also for oil to an extent.
segments.zh: 广东沿海大量进口LNG用于发电和工业。如果今夏高温导致水电出力下降，而中东供应受阻，中国可能面临天然气紧张，石油也有类似风险。
